name: Guangdong Dtech Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Dtech Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of tools, materials, and equipment in China and internationally. The company offers milling cutters, blades, and drill bits; and stainless steel pressure plate cleaning brushes, cutting force grinding brushes, non-woven fabric grinding brushes, ceramic grinding brushes, nylon grinding brushes, grinding circular sand belt mold brushes, diamond brush dressing plates, and golden finger grinding wheels.
